# Refactor Safety Checklist: Shared Conformance Harness and Duplicate-Key Check

**Purpose**: Pre-implementation author gate on the quality of the requirements for API
compatibility, behavior preservation, and zero-allocation performance
**Created**: 2026-10-01
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact.
Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality.
It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 - Does the spec enumerate every exported harness type whose source compatibility is required, rather than
  "the harnesses"? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK002 - Is the full exported surface that must not change (constructors, method signatures, validators,
  `pluginsdk` re-exports) listed in one place? [Completeness, contracts/exported-api.md]
- [ ] CHK003 - Are all three duplicate keys, including the composite billing-period key, defined precisely enough to
  show that equality semantics are unchanged? [Completeness, data-model.md]
- [ ] CHK004 - Is the internal second dial path used by spec validation covered by a requirement, not only an
  edge-case note? [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-007]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK005 - Is "the same pair" defined precisely, as the lowest later index together with the earliest matching
  index? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001, §US1-AS3]
- [ ] CHK006 - Is "keep their current error text, error wrapping, and error code" specific about which sentinel each
  dataset wraps? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK007 - Is "source-compatible" defined to cover the method sets reachable from the pointer types returned by
  the constructors? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK008 - Is the pairwise limit boundary stated unambiguously as inclusive (64 pairwise, 65 map)? [Clarity, Spec
  §FR-002, §Edge Cases]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK009 - Is the "all six harnesses" scope in Assumptions consistent with SC-002 and FR-006, and with the issue's
  "two copies" acceptance criterion? [Consistency, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK010 - Do the zero-allocation requirement (FR-004) and the plan's indirect key-call design agree that no
  closure capturing the page is used? [Consistency, research.md R1]
- [ ] CHK011 - Are the Stop-idempotence and Stop-before-Start scenarios consistent with the lifecycle in
  data-model.md? [Consistency, Spec §US2-AS2/AS3]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK012 - Can SC-001 and SC-002 ("exactly one" implementation) be checked objectively, for example by a named
  search? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001/002, quickstart.md]
- [ ] CHK013 - Is "no material regression" for the benchmark given a threshold, or explicitly stated as informational
  only? [Measurability, plan.md Performance Goals]
- [ ] CHK014 - Does SC-003 say which existing tests count as the behavior lock (allocation-free tests, conformance
  suites, integration tag)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]

## Scenario and Edge-Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK015 - Are empty, single-record, multiple-duplicate, and empty-string-key pages each covered by a requirement
  or scenario? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK016 - Is the ordering of nil-record rejection relative to the duplicate check stated as unchanged? [Coverage,
  Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK017 - Are `Unimplemented` responses for the RPC that the other supplemental harness lacks preserved by a
  requirement? [Coverage, Spec §US2-AS4]

## Dependencies and Assumptions

- [ ] CHK018 - Is the conflict surface with in-flight #579 and #580 documented and bounded to the harness block?
  [Assumption, research.md R3]
- [ ] CHK019 - Is the assumption that `go doc` lists methods promoted from an unexported embedded generic field
  documented with a verification step? [Assumption, research.md R2, quickstart.md step 4]

## Notes

- `/speckit-implement` reads this checklist's state but does not change the markers.
